welcome.text: Ah, you’re here! Before we head to the market, could you pass me that cup of chai?
welcome.speaker: harpreet

cupHint.text: A warm cup of chai. Tap Harpreet to give it to him, or drag the cup onto him.
cupHint.speaker: harpreet

cupSpill.text: Tea belongs in a cup, not on my sofa! Try giving it to me.
cupSpill.speaker: harpreet

cantCombine.text: Those don’t go together. Try another object.
cantCombine.speaker: harpreet

badDrop.text: Drop it onto something that can use it. Or tap the item, then its target.
badDrop.speaker: harpreet

ask.text: Before we rush off… could you pass me that chai?
ask.speaker: harpreet

teaHow.text: Drag the cup on the table onto me. Or tap the cup, then tap me.
teaHow.speaker: harpreet

teaDone.text: Now that’s a proper cup of chai. One sip and I can think again…
teaDone.speaker: harpreet

question.text: Where should we look for my scooter key?
question.speaker: harpreet

characterHome.text: That’s me! Tap the sofa to sit down, or choose what to ask.
characterHome.speaker: harpreet

characterYard.text: Ready for a ride. Tap the scooter to help me onto it.
characterYard.speaker: harpreet

sofaSit.text: Ahh. This sofa is dangerously comfortable. But the market won’t wait!
sofaSit.speaker: harpreet

stand.text: Right. Back to our little adventure.
stand.speaker: harpreet

cupboardBlocked.text: That’s my cupboard. Pass me the chai first — I’ll remember what I was doing.
cupboardBlocked.speaker: harpreet

cupboardEmpty.text: Just the usual odds and ends now. The key is safely in your pocket.
cupboardEmpty.speaker: harpreet

cupboardVisible.text: There it is, on the middle shelf. Tap the little golden key.
cupboardVisible.speaker: harpreet

cupboardFound.text: Of course! I put it away while tidying up. There’s the key, on the shelf.
cupboardFound.speaker: harpreet

keyFound.text: Found it! Keep the key in your pocket. Let’s see if the scooter is ready.
keyFound.speaker: harpreet

keySelected.text: Key selected. Tap the scooter outside, or drag this key onto it.
keySelected.speaker: harpreet

keyUsed.text: The key has already unlocked the scooter.
keyUsed.speaker: harpreet

yardLocked.text: My trusty old scooter. Now, if only I could find the key…
yardLocked.speaker: harpreet

yardUnlocked.text: There she is. Drag me onto the scooter, or tap me and then the scooter.
yardUnlocked.speaker: harpreet

homeTea.text: Back home. Let’s try that cupboard by the door.
homeTea.speaker: harpreet

homeFresh.text: A little chai before we head out? The cup is on the table.
homeFresh.speaker: harpreet

homeKey.text: Key in your pocket. The scooter is waiting outside.
homeKey.speaker: harpreet

scooterLocked.text: Locked! No amount of hopeful staring will start this scooter.
scooterLocked.speaker: harpreet

scooterUnlocked.text: Unlocked! Drag Harpreet onto the seat. Or tap Harpreet, then the scooter.
scooterUnlocked.speaker: harpreet

scooterReady.text: Ready when you are. Let’s go!
scooterReady.speaker: harpreet

keyUnlocked.text: That’s the one! A satisfying click. Now help me onto the scooter.
keyUnlocked.speaker: harpreet

mounted.text: Perfect! Key in. Shall we head to the market?
mounted.speaker: harpreet

keyHint.text: Tap the key in your pocket, then tap the scooter. You can drag it there too.
keyHint.speaker: harpreet

needKey.text: The key is still inside the house. Tap the home doorway to return.
needKey.speaker: harpreet

departure.text: Next stop: the market. Hold on to your shopping list!
departure.speaker: harpreet

finished.text: Mission complete. One small errand, one very good cup of chai.
finished.speaker: harpreet
